distribution.summary: 河南；陕西；江西；四川；云南
distribution.narrative: Mainland China is confirmed by 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015). 殷蕙芬等 (1984) records Henan, Shaanxi, Jiangxi, Sichuan and Yunnan; 黄复生等 (2015) retains Henan, Jiangxi, Sichuan and Yunnan and omits Shaanxi. Beaver & Liu (2010) treated the Taiwan report, based on three Shiraki specimens, as possible but requiring confirmation. Taiwan is therefore Questionable and excluded from the current distribution summary.

host_note: Pinus massoniana, Pinus tabulaeformis and Pinus yunnanensis are supported by both 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015). Beaver & Liu (2010) provides no host evidence for the doubtful Taiwan record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Tomicus minor (Hartig, 1834).
